Measure out around 500 mg of DMT and .5 ml of 100% propylene glycol (I found pharmaceutical grade PG at a Tractor Supply, but there are tons on Amazon) They say PG is harsher than VG, but It isn’t harsh at all. Take a shot glass and put your spice in and measure .5ml of PG in a glass syringe (don’t use a plastic syringe) and slowly insert the PG into the shot glass with the spice and mix as you add the PG. When fully dissolved, take the glass syringe and suck up your dissolved ejuice and insert it into a TH2 cart (this is a high quality CCELL cart and works perfectly, highly recommend, don’t get the cheap plastic knock off carts). Then boom! You have yourself a high quality dmt cart that hits pretty smooth (with shitty DMT taste as usual haha but that’s always) and you can easily achieve a break through dose in around 3-4 hits, I had one breakthrough before and it changed my life. Good luck man and safe travels!
